title: Duckling reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x='35' y='60' width='30' height='22' rx='2' fill='#d94a4a'/>
  <rect x='36' y='61' width='13' height='20' rx='1' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <rect x='51' y='61' width='13' height='20' rx='1' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='61' x2='50' y2='81' stroke='#b03030' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- book text lines -->
  <line x1='39' y1='65' x2='47' y2='65' stroke='#a0a0b0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='39' y1='68' x2='46' y2='68' stroke='#a0a0b0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='39' y1='71' x2='47' y2='71' stroke='#a0a0b0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='65' x2='61' y2='65' stroke='#a0a0b0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='68' x2='60' y2='68' stroke='#a0a0b0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='71' x2='61' y2='71' stroke='#a0a0b0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- duckling body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='48' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#ffe66b'/>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='54' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#f0c030' transform='rotate(-20 33 54)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='54' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#f0c030' transform='rotate(20 67 54)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='14' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='12' fill='#ffe66b'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='31' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='31' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='36' x2='50' y2='40' stroke='#e07030' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='36' r='2' fill='#ffb347' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='36' r='2' fill='#ffb347' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='84' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='84' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <!-- toes -->
  <line x1='38' y1='84' x2='36' y2='86' stroke='#e07030' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='85' x2='42' y2='87' stroke='#e07030' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='84' x2='48' y2='86' stroke='#e07030' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='84' x2='52' y2='86' stroke='#e07030' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='85' x2='58' y2='87' stroke='#e07030' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='84' x2='64' y2='86' stroke='#e07030' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
